name: Project Mods
description: MCP tools for registering per-project, entirely-local mods — a page an agent writes for ONE project, surfaced in that project's rail entry, tab-strip button, or a pinned background tab

tools.name: create_project_mod
tools.description: Register a page as a mod for the caller's project

tools.name: update_project_mod
tools.description: Replace a project mod's page and/or its metadata

tools.name: edit_project_mod
tools.description: Edit a project mod's page by exact substring replacement

tools.name: list_project_mods
tools.description: List the project mods for this project (or all of them)
